meta.name: collaborative-design
meta.description: Designs software features collaboratively through visual scenarios and iterative refinement. Use when designing features, tools, UIs, workflows, or any system before implementation.

copy.tagline: 协作设计软件功能，用视觉场景明确需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你在开发前需要协作设计软件功能
copy.tagline_en: Design software features collaboratively via visual scenarios
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to collaboratively design software features before implementation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会进入设计模式，针对软件功能先通过视觉场景（如输入输出对比、UI 草图）探索问题，而不是直接编码。它会引导你逐步明确需求、研究现有模式、推演流程，并在每一步展示选项让你选择。
howto.when: 当你提出设计新功能、工具、UI、工作流等系统时触发。适合在实现之前使用。

say.text: 设计一个用户注册流程
say.note: Claude 会展示注册步骤的视觉场景。

say.text: 我们来设计文件上传功能的界面
say.note: Claude 会画出界面状态转换。

say.text: 请帮我设计一个错误提示的处理方案
say.note: Claude 会展示输入输出对比。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude enters design mode for software features. It explores problems through visual scenarios (e.g., input/output pairs, UI mockups) before coding, guiding you to clarify needs, research patterns, walk through timelines, and present options for decisions at each step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention designing a new feature, tool, UI, workflow, or any system. Best used before implementation.

say_en.note: Claude will show visual scenarios of each step.

say_en.text: Let's design the file upload interface
Help me design an error handling approach
